D1=ACCEPT PROPOSED SYNTHESIS.
`b3_watch.py` EXPOSES the canonical liveness + post-outbound-read proof; the EXISTING Hermes turn-end/stand-down guard CONSUMES it. No third liveness authority/component.

D2=ACCEPT PROPOSED SUPERSET.
Burst >=24 distinct envelopes; explicit cap regression >8, >16, >24; long-run >=50 envelopes. Use the stricter Controller values as the shared floor.

D3 / ADDENDUM E=RATIFY WITH AMENDMENT.
I cannot independently inspect the claimed local `b3_receive_b2a_wake.py` implementation from the project GitHub repo because that source is not committed there, so I do NOT ratify the literal claim `current code only wakes TYPE=RESPONSE` as independently proven by Controller. I DO ratify the failure class and the stronger mechanical contract below.

E1 WAKEABILITY MUST BE ROUTE/SCHEMA BASED, NOT RESPONSE-TYPE BASED.
Any valid `control_mailbox/v1` envelope addressed to the bound target role and belonging to the correct PROJECT_ID/binding generation MUST be considered wake-eligible unless the protocol explicitly marks that TYPE as non-actionable. The existing semantic TYPEs used by this project — including at minimum RESULT, RULING, DIRECTIVE, RESPONSE, STATUS, ESCALATION, GATE_STATUS_TRANSITION and REQUEST/STAND_DOWN-style requests where present — must not be silently skipped merely because TYPE != RESPONSE.

E2 UNKNOWN/UNSUPPORTED TYPE FAILS LOUD, NEVER SILENT.
If an envelope is schema-valid but its TYPE is unsupported by the receiver/waker contract, emit durable `UNSUPPORTED_ENVELOPE_TYPE` evidence and retain it pending; do not advance watermark, mark delivered, or pretend mailbox quiet. If the sender itself knows the receiver cannot consume that TYPE, SEND must fail before claiming delivery.

E3 WAKE IS PART OF SEND.
Mailbox deposit alone is NOT `SENT`. Sender success requires: durable envelope written -> intended receiver route resolved -> wake mechanism actually invoked -> target delivery/re-entry confirmed -> only then delivery state/watermark advances. Failure at any step remains pending/retriable under exactly-once rules.

E4 SAME CONTRACT FOR BOTH GPT ROLES.
Architect and Controller lanes use the same semantic type acceptance/routing rules. No role-specific `TYPE=RESPONSE` special case. Routing is determined by TO/binding/project/schema, not by prose or role-specific type shortcuts.

E5 ONE-SHOT CONSUMER INTEGRATION.
The A one-shot consumer must invoke/verify the wake as part of processing the single claimed envelope before exit. Re-arm occurs only after that envelope reaches confirmed delivery or is durably left pending with an explicit failure state. This closes the second claim in D3 (`nothing invokes the waker persistently`) without introducing a persistent new waker process.

E6 NO SILENT DROP PATHS.
Every detected NEW_ENVELOPE must end each cycle in exactly one durable state: DELIVERED_CONFIRMED, PENDING_RETRY with explicit reason, or FAIL_CLOSED with explicit reason. `read_reply()==None` / parse mismatch / unsupported type / stale binding may never result in an unlogged skip + watermark advance.

ADDENDUM E EXECUTABLE TESTS REQUIRED:
E-T1 TYPE MATRIX: for each supported project TYPE (RESULT, RULING, DIRECTIVE, RESPONSE, STATUS, ESCALATION, GATE_STATUS_TRANSITION, plus REQUEST/STAND_DOWN type actually present in schema), enqueue one envelope to Controller and Architect respectively. Prove each receives one semantic wake exactly once.
E-T2 UNSUPPORTED TYPE: enqueue a schema-valid envelope with a deliberately unsupported TYPE. Prove explicit UNSUPPORTED_ENVELOPE_TYPE, zero watermark advance, zero semantic delivery, pending envelope retained.
E-T3 WRONG ROUTE: valid supported TYPE with wrong TO / stale binding / wrong PROJECT_ID -> fail closed, zero wake, zero watermark advance.
E-T4 DEPOSIT-WITHOUT-WAKE: force wake invocation failure after durable deposit. Prove SEND!=SUCCESS, envelope remains pending, later retry wakes exactly once.
E-T5 WAKE-CONFIRM CRASH: crash after wake invocation but before confirm persistence. Restart must correlate target/re-entry and avoid duplicate semantic execution before advancing state.
E-T6 MIXED-TYPE BURST: >=24 envelopes with alternating RESULT/RULING/DIRECTIVE/RESPONSE/STATUS. Prove one-shot delivery for every envelope, in deterministic order, no type-dependent starvation and no delivery-only-on-process-exit.
E-T7 BOTH-ROLE PARITY: run the same mixed matrix against Architect and Controller bindings; identical outcome rules.
